bounded_host_request.command:
python3 -B - <<'GACE_PY_READBACK'
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path("/home/admin1/server-core")
result = subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(root),"rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
print("HEAD_READ=" + ("PASS" if result.returncode == 0 else "FAIL"))
if result.returncode == 0:
    print("HOST_HEAD=" + result.stdout.strip())
try:
    target = json.loads((root/"operations/github-project-bounded-host.json").read_text())["result_return"]["issue_number"]
    print("RESULT_ISSUE=" + str(target))
except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
    print("RESULT_ISSUE=UNAVAILABLE")
path = pathlib.Path("/run/gace/servercore-result.sock")
print("SINK_SOCKET=" + ("PRESENT" if path.is_socket() else "MISSING"))
env = dict(os.environ)
if pathlib.Path("/run/user/" + str(os.getuid())).is_dir():
    env["XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"] = "/run/user/" + str(os.getuid())
try:
    status = subprocess.run(["systemctl","--user","is-active","gace-servercore-result-sink.service"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10,env=env)
    print("SINK_SERVICE=" + (status.stdout.strip() if status.returncode == 0 else "NOT_ACTIVE_OR_UNAVAILABLE"))
except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
    print("SINK_SERVICE=UNAVAILABLE")
GACE_PY_READBACK
